title: No Oil Orange Chicken

ingredients.name: marinade
items: 2-3 tbsp rice flour ( use as much as you need to form a coating ) ( can substitute with cornflour if you dont have rice flour in your pantry )
2 tbsp light soy ( if using dark, use max 1 tbsp as it will change the colour like in my video)
3-4 birds eye chilli, finely chopped ( i love the sweet and spicy combo, if you want it on the sweeter end, dont add the chilli) ( if you dont have birds ete chilli, use 1 green chilli )
white sesame seeds, for garnish + fresh coriander + birds eye chilli + orange slice

method: Marinate the chicken in all the ingredients mentioned above except the rice flour and leave for 30 minutes minimum max 12 hours
Add the rice flour just before you airfry the chicken
Preheat airfryer to 185 degrees and cook the chicken
While the chicken is cooking, make the sauce
In a pan on the stove, add your freshly squeezed orange juice, soy, brown sugar, orange zest, birds eye chilli, garlic, ginger and stir together and simmer for a minute
Add in the slurry to this and combine and let it thicken, this should take 1-3 minutes max
Add in the chicken and stir together coating the chicken
Top with white sesame seeds, orange slice, chilli and coriander if you have and serve fresh!!
This tastes great as is or on a bed of steamed rice
Box it up for your next day lunch with some steamed rice + fresh salad
caption:
No Oil Orange Chicken
high protein | low fat | easy dinner recipe | 30 minute recipe | weekday dinners | no oil recipe 

C: 29 | F: 5 | P: 37
Calories: 321 per serve 
Serves 3 - 4 depending on appetite 

Ingredients 
450 grams chicken breast, cubed
marinade:
1 tsp vinegar
1 tbsp dark soy sauce
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tsp minced ginger
1 tsp orange zest
2-3 tbsp rice flour ( use as much as you need to form a coating ) ( can substitute with cornflour if you dont have rice flour in your pantry ) 

sauce
3 oranges, freshly squeezed
2 tbsp light soy ( if using dark, use max 1 tbsp as it will change the colour like in my video)
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp orange zest
1 tbsp vinegar
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp minced ginger
3-4 birds eye chilli, finely chopped ( i love the sweet and spicy combo, if you want it on the sweeter end, dont add the chilli) ( if you dont have birds ete chilli, use 1 green chilli ) 
1 tbsp cornflour + 2 tbsp water

white sesame seeds, for garnish + fresh coriander + birds eye chilli + orange slice

Method 
marinate the chicken in all the ingredients mentioned above except the rice flour and leave for 30 minutes minimum max 12 hours 
add the rice flour just before you airfry the chicken 
preheat airfryer to 185 degrees and cook the chicken 

while the chicken is cooking, make the sauce
in a pan on the stove, add your freshly squeezed orange juice, soy, brown sugar, orange zest, birds eye chilli, garlic, ginger and stir together and simmer for a minute
add in the slurry to this and combine and let it thicken, this should take 1-3 minutes max
add in the chicken and stir together coating the chicken 
top with white sesame seeds, orange slice, chilli and coriander if you have and serve fresh!!

this tastes great as is or on a bed of steamed rice 

box it up for your next day lunch with some steamed rice + fresh salad
